            Privacy Settings

            We use cookies and similar technologies that are necessary to run our apps and websites. With your consent to one or more of the following processing purposes, you agree on the use of additional cookies and similar technologies which are required to fulfil the respective purpose:

            Analytics and Statistics

            We monitor our app and website to measure and improve their performance and evaluate the efficiency of our marketing campaigns.

            App and Website Personalization

            We track and analyze your online interactions (e.g. searches, clicks, chatbot interactions) to offer you products and services which meet your interests.

            Advertising

            We personalize online and social advertising by using collected data, building customer segments, sharing data with social media and advertising platforms, and embedding third-party content.

            You can withdraw or manage your consent at any time with future effect in the "Change Consent Settings" - section of the website footer.

            Analytics and Statistics

            • Performing aggregated analytics of our digital touchpoints.
            • Monitoring website traffic.
            • Measuring marketing channel performance.

            App and Website Personalization

            • Tracking interactions from previous and current visits on our apps and websites
            • Analyzing digital behavior, purchase and service interaction history
            • Determining digital preferences and providing personalized products and services on our apps and websites

            Advertising

            • Using collected data to increase the relevance and personalize online and social advertising
            • Building segments on specific customer groups to reconnect with our products along the whole customer journey
            • Sharing specific customer data with advertising and social media partners to match our customers interests
            • Embedding 3rd party content on our digital touchpoints
